name: SM_Hub_ShopKiosk_01
notes: Approved 20.0 x 8.0 x 7.6 stud wide horizontal Arena Shop Bar at (43, 150, -300) facing -X toward central Queue Portal at (0, 150, -300). Features continuous 15.1-stud bar counter, 2 extended side wings, lightweight suspended blank UI-ready SignPanel (GEO_ShopKiosk_SignPanel), 4 octagonal display pads (GEO_ShopKiosk_DisplayPad_01..04), and 4 replaceable non-spherical display items (GEO_ShopKiosk_DisplayItem_01..04: Hexagonal Emblem Plate, Vertical Halo Ring, Segmented Chevron Trail Fins, Geometric Starburst Burst Prism). Display-only in Alpha; optional simple collision proxy in meshes/collision_proxy/COL_ShopKiosk_Body.obj.
